notes.subject: feat(retrieval): upgrade LanceDB and drop Intel Mac support
notes.summary: Upgrades LanceDB and drops Intel Mac (darwin-x64) support; installers and the VS Code install commands now require Apple Silicon.

notes.subject: chore(vscode): require VS Code 1.140 and align API types
notes.summary: The VS Code extension now requires VS Code 1.140.0 or newer, so older editors can no longer install the current release.

notes.subject: fix(terminal): report shell output when native shell startup times out
notes.summary: Native shell startup timeouts now report the shell's last output, such as an update prompt, in the error and output channel log.

notes.subject: feat(cli): migrate multiline input to Ink 8
notes.summary: The CLI multiline composer moves to Ink 8 with a local editor supporting cursor movement, paste, and horizontal scrolling of long lines.

notes.subject: fix(terminal): keep tasks menu within the webview viewport
notes.summary: The terminal tasks menu now stays inside the webview viewport instead of overflowing the left edge in narrow panels.

notes.subject: fix(agent): restore pending ask_user cards for non-foreground chat tabs
notes.summary: Pending ask_user questions in non-foreground chat tabs are now persisted and restored on reload instead of being treated as interrupted.

notes.subject: fix: address triaged tool feedback
notes.summary: Fixes search_files match limits and offsets, ignores no-op document version bumps in edit review, logs sandbox probe errors, and warns when attaching to an outdated browser gateway helper.

notes.subject: fix(openai-compatible): count inline images at a fixed cost in usage fallback
notes.summary: Inline images are now counted at a fixed token cost in the OpenAI-compatible usage fallback, preventing repeated automatic condensing after a screenshot.

notes.subject: fix: address triaged tool feedback
notes.summary: Budget-exhausted background results include a completed-tool digest, sandboxed gh keyring failures get host-credential guidance, more config secrets are redacted, and compose telemetry records rejected children.

notes.subject: fix(tools): refuse write_file rewrites that replace secrets with the redaction placeholder
notes.summary: write_file now refuses full rewrites of structured config files that would replace existing secret values with the [REDACTED] placeholder.

notes.subject: chore(release): desktop-v0.10.0, cli-v0.11.0, sdk-v0.7.1
notes.summary: Release bookkeeping commit that updates version metadata, the lockfile, and changelogs without changing shipped behaviour.

notes.subject: fix(agent): offer history migration when an untitled workspace is saved
notes.summary: When an untitled multi-folder workspace is saved to a .code-workspace file with the same folders, AgentLink now offers to migrate the earlier chat history into the saved workspace.

notes.subject: fix(node-host): bind Codex OAuth callback to loopback and allow requiring Secret Service
notes.summary: Codex sign-in callback now listens only on loopback and ignores requests with the wrong state, and SDK hosts gain listenForCallback() and a linuxStore option to require Secret Service for credential storage.

notes.subject: feat(agent): add Codex voice input to the chat composer
notes.summary: Adds a composer microphone button for Codex voice dictation in VS Code, browser, Ask Agent and Desktop, plus a new transcribeCodexAudio SDK API in @agentlink/core/codex.

notes.subject: feat(voice): live dictation with pause detection, auto-stop, and push-to-talk
notes.summary: Voice input now transcribes live at natural pauses, auto-stops after configurable silence, supports push-to-talk (hold the mic or Alt+M), shows a live level and timer, and can optionally auto-send hands-free dictations.

notes.subject: feat(core): expose live dictation helpers as @agentlink/core/voice
notes.summary: Adds a browser-safe @agentlink/core/voice entry point with a pause-based voice activity segmenter, PCM resampler and WAV encoder for live dictation, which the VS Code recorder and browser capture now import from core.

notes.subject: docs(core): guide for adding a voice input button with @agentlink/core
notes.summary: Adds a voice input button guide to the core package, with a README Voice input section and a bundled documentation skill summary; no runtime behaviour changes.

notes.subject: feat(web): lend Codex OAuth web tools to every model
notes.summary: web_search and web_fetch now work on any model by borrowing the ChatGPT/Codex OAuth standalone web route when signed in, in VS Code and Browser Ask Agent; tool descriptions advise trying native web first, then MCP web tools.

notes.subject: feat(web): lend Codex OAuth web tools to every model
